units: <cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 14:6">Zeb. XIV, 6</cite> <he>בכל הר׳</he> were permitted to be eaten within the entire range of sight (around Shiloh); (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 881:7">Yalk. Deut. 881</cite> <he>בכל מקום שאתה רואה</he>); <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:12">Num. R. s. 14<sup>7</sup></cite>.

Zeb. 118ᵇ ר׳ שאמרו ר׳ כולו וכ׳ the range of sight of which they speak means a spot from where you can overlook the entire place with nothing to intercept &c.; לא ר׳ כולו אלא ר׳ מקצתו by roëh is meant the view not only of the entire place but also of a part of it.
